title: Spaghettini with Bacon and Basil
description: Thin pasta tossed with bacon, lots of garlic, a pinch of chilli and cherry tomatoes cooked just until they burst, finished with Parmesan and basil.

steps.heading: Cook the Pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta in a pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to the bite. Drain, keeping 1 cup of the cooking water, and return the pasta to the pot.

steps.heading: Make the Sauce
steps.text: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add the bacon and crushed red pepper and sauté until the bacon is crisp, about 4 minutes. Add the tomatoes and sauté until soft, about 4 minutes.

steps.heading: Toss
steps.text: Tip the tomato mixture into the pot with the pasta. Add ¾ cup of the cheese and 2 tbsp of the basil and toss over medium heat until the cheese melts and the sauce coats the pasta, adding cooking water ¼ cup at a time if it looks dry. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.heading: Serve
steps.text: Transfer to a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining basil. Serve the rest of the cheese alongside.

notes: Also in the family file as “Bacon and Tomato Pasta” made with angel hair — the same recipe.
